title: Austria Caught Between Austerity and Stagnation · 21 Aug
keywords: Austria economy, Austrian budget, fiscal consolidation, inflation Austria 2026, WIFO GDP, reform dividend, eurozone fiscal rules, EU deficit, austerity, Austrian coalition, OeNB, cost of living Austria
notes: Austria's new coalition government is pushing a fiscal consolidation drive it calls a gateway to future tax relief, but the country's economy stagnated in the second quarter of 2026 and inflation continues to squeeze household budgets. The so-called "reform dividend" debate has become the defining political fault line of the year, pitting fiscal hawks against critics who warn that austerity risks deepening an already fragile recovery. With the EU deficit forecast still elevated and public patience wearing thin, the stakes extend well beyond Vienna.
